evidence.r1: Glass is restricted to compare, tool and culling controls; the metadata sidebar and filmstrip are opaque.
evidence.r2: The expanded exposure palette replaces the narrow tool surface, with neutral filled inner selections rather than nested glass.
evidence.r3: Three glass groups handle compare, adjustments and culling without decorating the content panels.
evidence.r4: The compare strip, tool palette and culling bar share a dark cloudy regular-glass treatment.
evidence.r5: No clear-glass variant is visible; all floating controls use dark diffusing material.
evidence.r6: No saturated control tint is visible; Pick and the selected controls use neutral fills.
evidence.r7: The normal exposure palette visibly diffuses the forge photograph and the reduced controls become solid grey.
evidence.r8: The tool and culling bars use capsule silhouettes and the expanded palette uses fixed rounded corners.
evidence.r9: The selected Edit segment is inset with smaller rounded corners, and the Pick capsule follows the culling-bar end.
evidence.r10: The Pick action is a capsule and the compact compare segments are rounded rectangles.
evidence.r11: Compare, tool adjustment and culling actions occupy three separate related groups.
evidence.r12: Text-only compare and culling controls have separate glass backgrounds from the icon-tool and slider palette.
evidence.r13: The material wraps the whole compare strip and adjustment palette rather than individual glyphs or slider labels.
evidence.r14: The exposure menu and tool icons form one expanded continuous surface rather than adjacent floating panes.
evidence.r15: The filmstrip scroll region is below the floating controls, with no unnecessary scroll-edge treatment over the stationary stage.
evidence.r16: The forge photograph supplies varied colour and detail behind all three floating control groups.
evidence.r17: The expanded exposure palette covers the photographed tool and glowing workpiece in the resting menu capture.
evidence.r18: The dark palette text is legible, but there is no light-mode capture establishing both-mode contrast ratios.
evidence.r19: The reduced-transparency controls remain visible, but increased-contrast and reduced-motion behavior is not captured.
evidence.r20: The selected photograph is inset in a dark stage beside a hard-edged metadata sidebar rather than reaching the window edges.
evidence.r21: The photograph stops at a rectangular stage edge before the sidebar, with no visible background extension behind it.
evidence.r22: The floating compare and adjustment surfaces have material edges without separate custom backing panels.
evidence.r23: The exposure still suggests an expanded control but does not demonstrate morph timing or pointer-local press feedback.
evidence.r24: The compare, culling and exposure controls are monochrome while saturated orange remains in the photographs.
evidence.r25: White control labels sit on dark diffused photographic material rather than similar-coloured photograph detail.
